name: pm-sp
description: pm on Superpowers: Joe's project-management layer wrapped around a trimmed copy of Jesse Vincent's Superpowers (brainstorming with the visual companion, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, finishing a branch, TDD, debugging, verification) without its session-start takeover, and the Matt Pocock skills it uses for foggy work (wayfinder, grilling, domain-modeling, codebase-design, prototype, research, pr), so no other plugin is needed. pm-sp adds the session layer (whats-next, stepping-away, checkpoint), nested-sessions for plan lanes, second-opinion (Sol via Ringer plus a fresh Opus, on designs and branches), ship-acceptance, the credential guard, gate-hooks, review-policy and ui-test. An alternative to pm: install one or the other, and nothing else alongside.
